summary_en: This study tests isatuximab given with lenalidomide as maintenance therapy after stem cell transplant in adults with high-risk multiple myeloma. Isatuximab is given into a vein over about 75 minutes, and lenalidomide is taken by mouth; study drugs start about 60 to 180 days after transplant and may be given for about 3 years. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa isatuximab administrado junto con lenalidomida como terapia de mantenimiento después de un trasplante de células madre en adultos con mieloma múltiple de alto riesgo. Isatuximab se administra en una vena durante unos 75 minutos, y la lenalidomida se toma por vía oral; los medicamentos del estudio comienzan entre 60 y 180 días después del trasplante y pueden administrarse durante unos 3 años. El resultado principal no está indicado; este es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 72 with newly diagnosed symptomatic multiple myeloma and measurable disease
High-risk myeloma by R-ISS or ISS stage, or by specified genetic abnormalities
Partial response or better before starting maintenance therapy
Karnofsky score of at least 70% and/or ECOG performance status 2 or less
Autologous stem cell transplant with melphalan-based conditioning and adequate blood count recovery
not_for: Myeloma progression before starting maintenance therapy
Other investigational agents within 14 days or 5 half-lives before study treatment
Known allergy to study drugs or similar compounds, or to other listed components
Active infection requiring treatment or uncontrolled serious illness
HIV, or active hepatitis A, B or C; or major surgery within 4 weeks before treatment
